# Summer VAT Calculator

> Free UK Summer VAT relief calculator for the Great British Summer
> Savings (25 June – 1 September 2026). Calculates the correct 5%
> summer price for children's dine-in meals, child or family cinema
> and theatre tickets, and attraction admissions, applying HMRC penny
> rounding (VATREC12030). Published by Intelligenti Ltd.

## Quick facts

- **Relief window:** 25 June 2026 to 1 September 2026 (inclusive).
- **Rate change:** UK VAT drops from 20% to 5% on qualifying supplies.
- **Correct calculation:** for a price that includes 20% VAT, multiply by **0.875** (12.5% off). Not 15% off — that is the most common mistake.
- **Quick check:** the customer saving is 15% of the *net* price (price × 15 ÷ 120 on a VAT-inclusive figure).
- **Eligible:** children's dine-in meals from a children's menu; child or family cinema and theatre tickets; admissions to theme parks, water parks, museums, zoos, aquariums, soft play and similar.
- **Not eligible:** takeaway, delivery, adult-menu items, adult-only tickets, pay-per-ride charges, sports facilities, general retail.

## Documentation

- [Home — calculator and overview](https://summervatcalculator.co.uk/): Interactive calculator with HMRC penny rounding, eligibility cards and the App Store link.
- [The maths — why subtract 15% is wrong](https://summervatcalculator.co.uk/maths/): Step-by-step working showing that the correct adjustment is ×0.875 because 1.05 ÷ 1.20 = 0.875.
- [What qualifies for 5%](https://summervatcalculator.co.uk/#what-qualifies): Eligible categories and clear exclusions.
- [FAQ](https://summervatcalculator.co.uk/#faq): Common questions about the relief window, eligibility and the calculation method.

## Apps

- [iOS app on the App Store (id 6774140450)](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6774140450): Full-featured calculator with bundle support, history, on-device receipt scanning (Apple Vision) and a business mode for adjusting back-office records.
